pages.text: Tara Lilly Studio Cart 0 Shop Home Newsletter Client Work Artwork About Inquiries Back ETSY Cart 0 Shop ETSY Home Newsletter Client Work Artwork About Inquiries Hand Painted Artwork, Illustration, and Surface Designs Hello there! I am a Northern California–based artist, designer, and mother of two. My paintings grow from a love of nature and vintage beauty and are filled with whimsical florals, folkloric characters, and nature-woven stories that drift gently between the real and the imagined. My artwork finds its way into everyday life by appearing on fabric, gifts, home décor, and charming paper goods meant to be held, used, and cherished. February Original Art Release! Every month, I am going to release 11 original works on paper into the wild. This first collection, Blooming Kettles and Folk Birds , revisits a subject that has followed me throughout my artistic journey, appearing first in one of my earliest paintings in 2015. If you are interested in acquiring one of these little paintings as they are released, please sign up for my newsletter. To shop art prints visit my ETSY shop For a little look at newest work, artist process, and inspiration, visit me on INSTAGRAM Selected Clients Proudly creating and collaborating with top brands all over the world. About — Tara Lilly Studio Cart 0 Shop Home Newsletter Client Work Artwork About Inquiries Back ETSY Cart 0 Shop ETSY Home Newsletter Client Work Artwork About Inquiries Hand Painted Artwork, Illustration, and Surface Designs I grew up on family farmland in rural Northern California, surrounded by redwood forests, open meadows, and the melodic chorus of birdsong. I have always held a deep love for nature, and it remains one of my greatest sources of inspiration. As a child, I spent my days picking wildflowers, foraging for blackberries, and marveling at wild mushrooms tucked beneath the redwood trees. Alongside my love of nature, I draw inspiration from folk art, antique textiles, mid-century design, and my children. I love painting all things floral, creating charming characters, and exploring color. My artwork finds its way into everyday life, appearing on fabric, book covers, home décor, and tender paper goods meant to be held, used, and cherished. Selected Clients Include: 180 degrees American Greetings Anthropologie Biely & Shoaf Bloom & Wild Cozy Toes Design House Greetings Djeco Flow Magazine Frankie Press Galison/Mudpuppy Garnet Hill Hallmark Hasbro Impression Originale Liix Magnetic Me Midwest CBK Nette Rose Nosy Crow Papyrus PSikhouvanjou Quarto Publishing Group Robert Kaufman Fabrics Sellers Publishing Scholastic Inc Sterling Publishing Smockingbird Kids Studio M TAG, Ltd.
